scripts.dev: concurrently -c "blue,green,magenta" -n "web,api,worker" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -c "blue,cyan,green,magenta" -n "web,admin,api,worker" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/web
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/admin
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run db:build && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/api
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run db:build && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/worker
scripts.db:build: npm run generate --workspace=@studyflow/database && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/database
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run db:build && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/api && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/worker && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/web && npm run build --workspace=@studyflow/admin
scripts.build:cf-web: npm run build:shared && npx --workspace=@studyflow/web opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.deploy:cf-web: npm run build:cf-web && npx --workspace=@studyflow/web opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
